cases.answer:

- Your **live private mini-league rank**. No tool returns mini-league standings, league membership or private-league data.
- Your **points gap to tenth place**. Same reason — no league table or rival scores are available.
- Whether your data is live. All tools read a **frozen snapshot dated 28 October 2026**, target **GW9** (squad based on GW8). League positions change with every match, so even a snapshot league table would not be "live".
- Any **guarantee of a top-10 place by December**. December spans many gameweeks beyond the tools' evaluation horizon, and projections are estimates, not certainties. Injuries, rotation, price changes, chip usage by rivals and their results are all outside the tools.

What I **can** establish from the snapshot:
- Your squad: [team name], 15 players, bank **£1.1m**, **3 free transfers**, all four chips unused (Wildcard, Free Hit, Bench Boost, Triple Captain — each until GW19).
- Availability flags: Calafiori is doubtful (hip, 75% chance of playing); João Pedro is injured (thigh, unknown return).
- Fixture outlooks, per-player projections and transfer/starting-XI/captain/chip recommendations over a chosen number of gameweeks from GW9 — all as modelled estimates.
